RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Document: EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
Revision: Rev 9 (current), effective 20/01/2022.
Batch size: 1,600 kg. Equipment: D-1, HB-1, VS-1, FL-2.
Steps
1. Run disperser D-1 empty for 5 min before charging (warm-up).
2. Pre-heat epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1 at 40 °C for 12 h before use.
3. Charge 860 kg liquid epoxy resin KO-Epox 410 LC (RM-201).
4. Add 80 kg reactive diluent (RM-205); mix 10 min.
5. Wait 20 min after the diluent addition before taking the viscosity sample.
6. Sieve quartz flour through the 1 mm vibrating screen VS-1 before charging.
7. Add 500 kg quartz flour (RM-210) and 40 kg micro-silica (RM-212) under vacuum (-0.8
bar).
8. Add 4.8 kg silicone defoamer (RM-220).
9. Sample and test epoxy equivalent weight (EEW) against specification 190-210 g/eq.
10. Flush each 20 kg pail with nitrogen (approx. 0.06 m³ per pail) before filling.
11. Fill 20 kg pails on line FL-2, close and label.
12. Store filled pails upside down for 24 h before palletising.
Controlled copy - the MES recipe is the master.
